##### Project general facts

Radisson Resort Maldives represents a landmark collaboration between the globally renowned Radisson Hotel Group and the international developer Teus Group, marking a new branded hospitality development on Thulusdhoo Island in the Maldives. This project introduces an accessible investment opportunity within one of the world's most recognized tourism destinations, allowing investors to participate in the growing hospitality market through a professionally managed resort operated in accordance with Radisson brand standards.

With a collection of hotel rooms and private villas, the development combines international hospitality expertise with a practical investment model designed to provide attractive rental income potential. The property operates under a transparent long-term leasehold structure. The project is being developed on a legally registered leasehold land parcel and in accordance with the applicable regulatory framework of the Maldives, providing investors with a clear and structured ownership model.

Every aspect of the resort is designed to deliver a comfortable and enjoyable guest experience. Guests and residents will enjoy a planned oceanfront infinity pool, an ocean-view spa, an overwater restaurant, a landscaped beachfront area, a beachfront cinema, and a range of recreational facilities. A mangrove labyrinth offers a unique island experience, while co-working spaces and conference facilities support the growing demand for flexible work-and-travel lifestyles.

Each room and villa is designed in line with the concept of contemporary hospitality, balancing comfort, functionality, and modern design. Units feature high-quality materials, efficient layouts, contemporary finishes, spacious terraces, and large windows designed to maximize natural light and ocean views. Every element reflects the operational and design standards expected from an internationally recognized hospitality brand while maintaining a practical and welcoming resort environment.

##### Parking
Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled on an inhabited island, this exceptional location places visitors just a short speedboat journey from the main international gateway to the Maldives. This proximity offers significant convenience, eliminating the need for additional domestic flights or seaplane transfers and supporting strong accessibility for a broad range of travelers. The island is surrounded by a crystal-clear lagoon and white sandy beaches, creating the natural tropical setting for which the Maldives are renowned.

The location is internationally recognized for its world-class surf breaks, attracting surfers from around the globe. Guests also have the opportunity to observe marine life in its natural habitat and enjoy access to numerous nearby dive sites suitable for different experience levels. Together, these attractions support a diverse range of recreational and water-based activities throughout the year.

Beyond its natural assets, the island offers significant operational advantages. With established infrastructure already in place, including power grids, water supply, sewage systems, roads, and staff accommodation, the development benefits from lower infrastructure requirements compared to many remote private island projects. This approach helps reduce certain development challenges while supporting operational efficiency.

Unlike many ultra-luxury Maldivian resorts, the project is intentionally positioned within the underserved branded midscale hospitality segment. This strategy allows the resort to appeal to a broader guest audience while maintaining international service standards under the Radisson brand. Combined with its location on an inhabited island and efficient operating model, the project is designed to meet the growing demand for high-quality, internationally branded accommodation in the Maldives.
